title: A Path Towards Legal Autonomy: An interoperable and explainable approach to extracting, transforming, loading and computing legal information using large language models, expert systems and Bayesian networks
reasoning: The paper includes a significant discussion on the ethical responsibility and accountability of AI agents, arguing that for AI decisions to be socially acceptable and 'ethically untenable' if unexplainable, they must be traceable to their underlying logic and data. It connects its proposed technical system to principles of ethical philosophy and the necessity of maintaining human trust through ethical alignment.
